## Problem and behaviour

State the concrete trigger and resulting behaviour. Link the issue and versioned spec/plan/tasks.

## Acceptance and verification

| Acceptance criterion | Test or manual evidence | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AC- | | |

- Red: commit, exact command and intended failure reason.
- Green: exact command and passing result; relevant regression checks.
- Review: separate reviewer/report and resolved findings.
- UI changes: desktop/mobile screenshots and accessibility checks where affected.
- Reuse: source/version, licence/notice, selected parts and brand/industry customisation.
- Release: staging evidence, migration/rollback where relevant, known limitations.

Update the feature's `verification.json`. The artifact gate checks consistency, not the truth of
test/review claims. A draft PR is not a merge or production release. Do not attach private client
data, credentials or raw customer transcripts.
